cues.text: MarketView puts over 320 markets across Nigeria and Kenya in one place.
Each one validated through 19 data sources, including government enumerators and market leaders.
Reach into a mapped footprint of nearly 500,000 market actors — the traders and aggregators who actually move your commodity.
See what your commodity costs across markets, then decide where to buy without sending someone to every one.
Find, compare and reach suppliers faster.
MarketView. Join the NABG cohort, or book a sprint.
